title: Run native EditMode tests through jobs

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Build mcp-server and open the demo with bridge, verify and the Editor-only project-command fixture. Use one persistent MCP session. Preserve existing dirty scenes/settings and snapshot only disposable fixture files before mutation.

steps.title: Run native EditMode tests through jobs
steps.payload: Start unity_senses_run_tests through jobs for UnityOpenMcpBridge.Tests.ProjectCommandCatalogTests, ProjectCommandInvocationTests and GatePolicyTests, using separate keys and include_passes:false. Call status then wait for each terminal result. Run Demo.Tests.ExampleEditModeTests.Addition_WorksCorrectly through the direct synchronous tool. Run Example_FailingTest through jobs as an intentional failure control; its failed summary must be retained.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: Selected positive native suites have nonzero totals and zero failures; the intentional failing demo method produces one failed test and a failed job. No synthetic gate is added.
Direct synchronous runner retains its terminal behavior.

reset.note: Wait for terminal execution before restoring saved fixture bytes under Assets/_ValidationSuite/ProjectCommands. Preserve pre-existing files, scene changes and settings. Never restart an uncertain operation for cleanup.
